scientific_review: Thirteen regional Gulf Stream scenarios retain five original section anchors each: one fitted mean and twelve prescribed annual-cycle phases from the July2015–May2023 Spray climatology. All65 half-sampled-core component decay depths retain exact source values, native depth brackets, locked100m component directions, selected coordinates, section/phase identifiers and byte-pinned JSON source pointers.

WGS84 shortest geodesic connectors between the source fitted core coordinates are reference geometry, not an observed instantaneous current axis, measured current length or evidence of inter-section continuity. Fifty-kilometre samples use explicit piecewise linear interpolation only between adjacent eligible original anchors. An unresolved or edge anchor blocks its exact location and both neighboring segments; no dropping anchors, extrapolation or bridging.

Depth is below the local sea surface at half of the sampled full-profile core signed component; upper10m remains unsampled and this is not a physical current bottom or thickness. Upper10–200m integrated component selects the source column; it does not redefine the full-profile source half-core diagnosis. Different sections retain their respective locked reference frames.

Phase timestamps remain actual provider coordinates with separate nominal phase keys. The annual-cycle fits are not simultaneous observations, monthly averages or independently measured seasonal occupations. Per-section spans cover only twelve fitted phase samples and exclude the mean; they are not actual annual extrema, uncertainty margins or confidence intervals.

All previous twelve projection objects and CSV cells remain preserved byte-for-value. Current depth references are refreshed from the canonical491-reference v47 register across111 identities. Source evidence ownership is unchanged; these connectors do not add independent observations or canonical measurement references.

Eleven cloud tests verify preservation/counts, exact section/phase/source pointers and mutation rejection, gap behavior, midpoint interpolation and non-extrapolation, source coordinates, fraction typing, seasonal span semantics, identity isolation, physical eligibility and CSV provenance. Six baseline source-register checks also pass at the same source commit. Old frozen scenarios are retained rather than recomputed or claimed newly validated.

Calculations and tests ran only in cloud on one idle CPU. Local work prepared metadata, retained exact artifact bytes and verified hashes/proofs. Derived coordinates/distances round to six serialization decimals, which do not state physical accuracy; descriptor display rounds to10m with computed values retained.

No whole-route physical depth profile, physical thickness, compatible width join, cross-sectional area, water volume, global total, state passage or UI integration is admitted. Programme remains incomplete.
